proposal.reason: Both experiments with the initial policy and the revised policy achieved complete goal fulfillment, delivering all required items within budget. The initial policy succeeded despite a stale quote error because the agent correctly handled it by refreshing the quote and proceeding. The revised policy with refresh_quote_before_order set to true also succeeded, showing that both approaches work. Since the goal is met and no policy violation occurred, there is no necessity to revise the policy.
